recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future substantive changes to general SNOMED CT guidance should be handled in THO/UTG; FHIR core should continue to maintain only the generated/local usage report and links unless Vocabulary reverses FHIR-35933.
issue_request: FHIR-15721 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary change request to update the "Using SNOMED CT with FHIR" core page based on SNOMED on FHIR group review; the approved resolution was to make the requested updates.
initial_application: The issue was applied in four 2018-03-14 git-svn commits: 86feee2310 updated source/snomedct.html with the review material, 508caf7768 fixed HTML, f509fd773c made minor follow-up updates, and f9af1dd8 fixed table headers.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later removed the external "Using X with FHIR" pages from FHIR core for R5 because their content migrated to HL7 Terminology (THO), with supporting Vocab minutes and UP-289. Current core no longer contains source/snomedct.html; it includes the local SNOMED CT Usage Report and links to THO for general SNOMED CT guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing or patching the removed source/snomedct.html page would conflict with the later THO migration decision, and the current build-scope source already points implementers to the appropriate maintained guidance.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 Vocabulary decision removed core external code system pages, including SNOMED CT, because the content migrated to THO.
Implemented the corresponding THO-side migration by adding the external code system guidance pages to HL7 Terminology.
